label: LaTeX
title: LaTeX
subtitle: Compiles LaTeX source files into PDF documents. Agents can write LaTeX, compile it to check for errors, and produce a final PDF output.
whenToUse: Use when producing academic papers, technical reports, or any document that requires precise typesetting, mathematical notation, or structured references. Requires Docker and a TeX Live image.

methods.name: Check LaTeX Status
methods.description: Checks whether Docker and a TeX Live image are available and ready.

methods.name: Pull TeX Live Image
methods.description: Pulls the TeX Live Docker image if it is not already present.

methods.name: Compile LaTeX Document
methods.description: Compiles a .tex file into a PDF and returns the compilation log.

mediaCaption: A LaTeX compilation action card showing the source file path, compilation log, and the path of the generated PDF
tips: LaTeX compilation requires Docker to be running.
Compilation errors are returned in the log — the agent can read the log and fix the source automatically.
